# Bent Metal Exteriors

> Eavestrough (gutter), soffit, fascia, and leaf guard installation, repair, and cleaning for homeowners in Calgary and Southern Alberta. Owner-operated, licensed and insured, with direct installer-to-homeowner pricing and free estimates.

Bent Metal Exteriors is a home exterior contractor based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. The company installs seamless aluminum eavestroughs roll-formed on site, downspouts, aluminum fascia capping, vented and non-vented soffit panels, and perforated aluminum leaf guard systems. All work is specified for Alberta's climate: heavy rain, rapid snowmelt, freeze-thaw cycles, and ice damming.

- Owner and operator: Justin Hanrahan (over a decade in Alberta exterior trades, started in roofing, on every job site)
- Phone: (403) 890-8442
- Email: info@bentmetal.ca
- Service area: Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, Okotoks, Red Deer, Lethbridge, Medicine Hat, Sundre, Brooks, and Southern Alberta generally
- Works year-round, including winter when weather windows allow
- Free, no-pressure estimates; response within one business day

- [About Us](https://bentmetal.ca/about_us/): Background on owner Justin Hanrahan and how roofing experience informs the gutter, soffit, and fascia work.
